name: English - English Pronunciation C1
description:
The course will review both segmental and non-segmental phonology (sounds and connected speech), covering areas such as vowel and consonant production, stress placement, and intonation in English.

Where appropriate, comparisons will be drawn between different languages as well as different varieties of English (e.g. U.S. varities and British English varieties).
prerequisites: This course is intended for those students who have either already completed the course 'Introduction to English Pronunciation' or whose pronunciation is already at a more adavanced level, and who wish to extend their knowledge and pratice their pronunciation further.
